record.one_liner: CRM and sales pipeline management platform with a REST API for deals, contacts, activities, and automation.
record.auth_notes: Direct/personal integrations use a per-user API token sent via the x-api-token header. Marketplace apps and the official MCP server use OAuth 2.0 authorization.
record.access_notes: Developers can request a free Developer Sandbox account via a signup form to build and test integrations against the live REST API, with no payment mentioned. Sandbox accounts are 5-seat and may be deactivated after inactivity (no apps created in 45 days, none published/live in 6 months).
record.api_breadth_basis: Vendor API reference lists 50+ endpoint categories including Deals, Persons, Organizations, Activities, Projects, Pipelines, Products, Files, Webhooks, Filters, Goals, and more, plus official OpenAPI 3 specs and Node.js/PHP client libraries.
record.blocker_notes: Free developer sandbox account plus documented REST API and OAuth2 support means no gating obstacle was found for building a toolkit; production use against real customer data would require the customer to have a Pipedrive account (trial or paid), but developer/API access itself is self-serve.
